subject: Coord: SE technical demo windows + security/procurement requirements
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + 60m SE demo — proposed windows (need procurement/sec attendees)

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. We’re excited to do a focused technical demo with our Solutions Engineering team to walk through inference latency/cost tradeoffs and the security posture for private deployments.

High level ask: can you please confirm who from your engineering/procurement/security teams should join? Procurement often needs to be on the call for network & licensing questions; SecOps usually wants the SOC2 and network diagram.

Proposed 60-minute windows (all in UTC for clarity):
- Option A: 2026-11-03 15:00–16:00 UTC
- Option B: 2026-11-04 09:00–10:00 UTC
- Option C: 2026-11-05 19:00–20:00 UTC (late evening PT)

We’ve attached a short demo agenda and a one-pager so folks can scan ahead. If none of those work, please drop 2–3 alternate windows and we’ll align.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate calendar invites once we lock a slot.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0186
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Priya Shah <pshah@acmecorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, AcmeCorp Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, AcmeCorp SecOps <secops@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + 60m SE demo — proposed windows (need procurement/sec attendees)

Hi Aditya —

Thanks — we should include Procurement (I've cc'd procurement@acmecorp.com) and SecOps (cc'd). A couple of notes and constraints from our side:

- Procurement can only do mornings ET; they asked for 09:30–11:30 ET windows.
- SecOps will want to see the SOC2 summary and a simple network diagram (they prefer attachments ahead of time).
- Two of our customer engineers (Sanjay and myself) will attend; Sanjay is in India (IST) and would prefer a UTC-friendly time, ideally between 12:00–17:00 UTC.

From the options above, Option B (2026-11-04 09:00 UTC) maps to 05:00 ET for us — too early for Procurement. Could you propose two alternatives that are:

1) within 12:00–17:00 UTC to accommodate Sanjay
2) also overlap at least 30 minutes with 09:30–11:30 ET for Procurement (that maps to 13:30–15:30 UTC)

We can share the SOC2 checklist and an internal contact for network questions if you send an ask list.

Thanks —
Priya Shah
Product Lead, AI Platforms | AcmeCorp
pshah@acmecorp.com | +1 (212) 555-0129
Attachment: acme-soc2-ask-list.docx (docx, 2 pages)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@acmecorp.com>, Sanjay Rao <s.rao@acmecorp.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, AcmeCorp Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, AcmeCorp SecOps <secops@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 07:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Intro + 60m SE demo — proposed windows (need procurement/sec attendees)

Priya / Sanjay —

Thanks for the constraints. Quick note from the SE side on structure and concrete windows to try to meet both sets of constraints (customer engineers in IST, procurement mornings ET, secops asks ahead of time):

Proposed 2 candidate slots (explicit UTC / local times):
- Candidate 1: 2026-11-10 13:00–14:00 UTC (09:00–10:00 ET / 18:30–19:30 IST) — overlaps Procurement early window by ~30m at the tail, and is within Sanjay's 12:00–17:00 UTC preference.
- Candidate 2: 2026-11-11 14:00–15:00 UTC (10:00–11:00 ET / 19:30–20:30 IST) — overlaps Procurement central window and sits squarely in Sanjay's window.

Agenda (60m):
1) 5m quick intros + desired outcomes
2) 25m live walk-through of a representative inference pipeline (latency measurements, KV-cache behavior, batching)
3) 20m security/network discussion (we’ll review SOC2 highlights, recommended VPC peering patterns, and SSO/SAML options)
4) 10m Q&A + next steps (procurement asks, pilot timeline)

Prep items we’ll send ahead of time:
- SOC2 summary and control mapping (PDF)
- Minimal network diagram + egress/port checklist (XLSX)
- Brief SAML/KMS slide (PPT)

Can you confirm which candidate is best for Procurement? If neither works we can do a shorter 30m technical sync to reduce scheduling friction. We’ll prepare a calendar invite and a Zoom link once you confirm.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0221
Attachment: network-requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)

We can take Candidate 2: 2026-11-11 14:00–15:00 UTC (10:00–11:00 ET). Procurement will join for the first 30 minutes; SecOps will be on for the security segment.
